From the very first frame, show the full body of the farmer standing on the far left side of the screen. The farmer must be visible from 0.0 seconds. No empty intro, no delayed entrance, no scene-only opening.

The farmer skips from screen left to screen right for the entire 10 seconds. The motion must be a real skip, not walking, not running, not marching.

Make the farmer perform a clear step-hop pattern:

left foot steps forward, then the farmer makes a small hop on the same left foot while the right knee lifts.

Then right foot steps forward, then the farmer makes a small hop on the same right foot while the left knee lifts.

Repeat this left step-hop, right step-hop rhythm continuously across the whole video.

The important visual detail is that one foot touches the ground twice in a row: step, then hop. The body rises upward during each hop. The boots briefly leave the ground. The knees alternate upward. The motion should feel playful, bouncy, and childlike.

Keep the same 2D illustrated style: elderly farmer, straw hat, white beard, white shirt, blue overalls, brown boots, red apple in hand, clean black outlines, flat soft colors. Use a side-view or three-quarter side-view so the legs are easy to see. Static wide camera, full body visible, no zoom, no pan, no camera shake. Simple sunny farm path background.

첫 프레임부터 화면의 가장 왼쪽에 서 있는 농부의 전신을 보여주세요. 농부는 0.0초부터 보여야 합니다. 빈 인트로, 지연된 등장, 장면만 있는 오프닝은 없습니다.

---
使用上传的农民插图仅作为角色参考。不要从原始图像的特写开始。创建一个新的10秒16:9视频。

从第一帧开始，显示农民的全身站在屏幕的最左侧。农民必须从0.0秒开始可见。没有空白的开头，没有延迟的出场，没有仅场景的开场。

农民在整个10秒内从屏幕左侧跳跃到右侧。动作必须是真正的跳跃，不是走路，不是跑步，不是行进。

让农民执行一个清晰的步跳模式：

左脚向前迈步，然后农民在同一只左脚上小跳一下，同时右膝抬起。

然后右脚向前迈步，然后农民在同一只右脚上小跳一下，同时左膝抬起。

在整个视频中连续重复这个左步跳、右步跳的节奏。

重要的视觉细节是，一只脚连续两次触地：步，然后跳。身体在每次跳跃时向上升起。靴子短暂离地。膝盖交替向上。动作应感觉到轻松、弹跳和孩子气。
